note: Navigation roadmap measured on the map geometry (game uu). nodes: [x, y, z(floor), clearance, zoneIndex]. edges: [a, b, halfWidth] walkable both ways along the straight segment; a body may stray halfWidth sideways and stay on walkable floor. drops: [from, to] one-way. links: authored special traversals.
